title: Ceiling-reject T2 golden pins the full-ceiling state, not the reject firing
evidence:
# The T2 captures show the FULL-ceiling state — a 9th pipe onto the mid / 17th
# onto the high would reject .Router_Ports_Full (the reject count is pinned by
# the core unit test test_mid_high_port_ceilings; a rejected command cannot
# ride a demo's action log — it would latch replay_error and fail the gate,
# so the golden is the ceiling state itself, the reject is the next draw).
detail: Briefing golden discipline asks for "T2 of an 8-port / 16-port ceiling reject (.Router_Ports_Full)"; the delivered router_ceiling goldens capture the full-ceiling state instead. Substitution is documented and the reject count is unit-tested (core/placement_test.odin:269), so coverage exists at a lower layer.
recommended_fix: No code change needed; PR body should state the ceiling golden is the pre-reject state with the reject pinned by test_mid_high_port_ceilings.
